Clinical Trial Feasibility · v0.9.5

Project

Describe the study, check the evidence, plan countries and sites, then take the decision report to the bid defense. Patient data is optional.

Settings

Technical tools: run mode, Expert view and the one-click pipeline run

Expert view shows the verification suites, vocabulary editor, generated query and extra diagnostic columns; inputs and decisions are visible in both views. “Run full pipeline” is the earlier one-click run: in Synthetic EMR demo mode it fills missing inputs with synthetic data, and in live web mode with neither a protocol nor an indication it loads the GastroNova UC example. Both are labelled as demo/example inputs. “Run analysis” in the main view never substitutes example data.

Technical workflow: the six-step pipeline view (same data and controls, organised by stage)

Manual Process
AI Automation
Core AI capabilities

    Selecting a stage or step opens the tab that holds it: Study (steps 1 and 3), Evidence (step 2), Plan (steps 4 and 5), Report (step 6).

    Processing runs in this browser tab. Imported patient records are never included in AI or registry requests.
    Privacy details

    Processing runs in this browser tab. The app does not include imported patient records in its API payloads; exports remain your responsibility. Raw patient extract text is not retained after import. This is pseudonymization, not a certified anonymization process. External fonts may be requested. Outbound study requests: search terms to ClinicalTrials.gov (public API), and, only when you add an Anthropic API key, the protocol text and study brief to Claude for parsing and country web research. When you select Gemini for protocol parsing and confirm a request, the protocol text is sent to Google.
